Python (requests):
```python
import os, requests
headers = {
  'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')}",
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  'X-Request-ID': 'rqd_01G7Z9Y2'
}
payload = {"model":"rwd-medium-1","input":"smoke test","max_tokens":4}
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=15)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

Node (fetch):
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` ,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-Request-ID': 'rqd_01G7Z9Y2'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-medium-1', input:'smoke test', max_tokens:4}),
    timeout: 15000
  });
  console.log(res.status, await res.text());
})();
```

Go (net/http):
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
  "io/ioutil"
)
func main() {
  body := []byte(`{"model":"rwd-medium-1","input":"smoke test","max_tokens":4}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  req.Header.Set("X-Request-ID", "rqd_01G7Z9Y2")
  client := &http.Client{Timeout: 15 * 1e9} // 15s
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("err:", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode, string(b))
}
```
